_comment: Without this, nodemon watches the whole server directory — including
uploads/, which the application itself writes to at runtime. Signing an
agreement, generating a POD, or a driver uploading proof all drop a file
in there, nodemon sees the change and restarts the API underneath the
request that caused it. The browser gets ECONNRESET on the request in
flight and ECONNREFUSED on everything until the restart finishes.
tests/ and scripts/ are ignored for the same reason at lower stakes: they
are not part of the running server, so editing a test should not bounce it.
